$comment: The v1.3 line's release-candidate tag for its PARALLEL compat credential window (founder decision 2026-10-08; four stable cells node/bun x turbopack/webpack, vinext Beta and uncredentialed). Independent of .github/compat-credential-ref.json, which pins the v1.0 window: a v1.3 bump restarts only the v1.3 window. Read from main by .github/workflows/compat-credential-v1.3.yml via scripts/compat-credential-line.mjs, which REFUSES a tag not on the v1.3 line. Bumping rcTag requires regenerating that workflow from the new tag in the same PR (docs/RELEASING.md).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: Lead decision 2026-10-10 (UTC), the 1.3.1 version-packages PR: carries the founder-requested PPR build-scope fix (backported to this line) into the 1.3.1 release. The shipped cache handler differs from v1.3.0-rc.10 by that fix plus version fields. 1.3.1 ships decoupled from the credential, as 1.3.0 did; the credential window keeps measuring the rc.10 bytes. rcTag is unchanged. Distinct from the backport PR's marker so the introduced-by-this-PR rule reads it as new.
